title: [Bug] Compaction Fails Unexpectedly with "Conversation Too Long" Error
body:
**Bug Description**
> /compact 
  ⎿  Error: Error during compaction: Error: Conversation too long. Press esc twice to go up a few messages and try again.

────── THIS HAPPENS even if i have 99% of my context window left. So this is a SERIOUS bug. Calling /compact manually crashes EVERY TIME.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vte-based
- Version: 1.0.120
- Feedback ID: 415483f2-980d-400c-92d1-21c3e30c33b5

top_comments.author: jMyles
top_comments.body: I'm having the same issue.  It feels increasingly urgent; I'm completely unable to compact now.

top_comments.author: mfagerlund
top_comments.body: Same here - but oddly enough claude code can itself compact later on. But it's highly annoying because I like to compact early and often.

top_comments.author: dimension-zero
top_comments.body: Getting this lots today.  This bug is truly crazy: the compact feature that is designed to shorten conversations itself can't handle conversations that need to be compacted!  It falls prone to the problem it is meant to solve!
